summary: A sudden spike in HTTP 5xx errors was observed on checkout‑api at 12:06:10 UTC. Log analysis shows a burst of KeyError exceptions in the /checkout route, all originating from version v1.1.0 deployed minutes earlier. Metrics confirm 75 out of 391 requests (19% error rate) returned 5xx responses. The deployment introduced a new currency context that is missing in some requests, causing the KeyError and the observed outage.

timeline.description: v1.0.0 is the last known good release.
Deploy v1.1.0 (Add currency context to pricing).
Health check reports service OK, masking underlying exception.

evidence.quote: Observed 75 HTTP 5xx responses among 391 requests. RSS ranged from 0.3 to 75.8 MiB.

next_steps: Add validation for missing currency field.
Update release notes to reflect the regression.

proposed_actions.reason: KeyError caused by missing currency context in v1.1.0 deployment.
Ensure all instances pick up the rolled‑back code cleanly.
